test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

g u k _ r _ _ u _ m r t _ u _ m _ t

options.text: m t g k g r k
m t g k g k r
m g t r g k r
r t g k m k r

solution:
Given: g u k _ r _ _ u _ m r t _ u _ m _ t 

1. m t g k g r k → g u k **m **r **t - g **u **k **m r t - **g **u **r **m **k **t

2. m t g k g k r → g u k m r t - g u k m r t - g u **k** m **r** t

3. m g t r g k r → g u k m r **g** - **t** u **r** m r t - g u **k** m **r** t

4. r t g k m k r → g u k **r** r t - g u k m r t - **m** u **k** m **r** t

 
• Option (2) follow the cycle of **gukmrt**

Hence, the correct answer is **"m t g k g k r"**
